i_collie.lore.legendary: Grew its winter coat so thick that the shepherds moved into it for the season. The sheep visit at weekends.
i_collie.lore.rare: Brushes itself against the hedge every morning and leaves a fluffy collar on every branch. Birds have started lining their nests with it.

i_clumber.lore.epic: Lay down in a snowy field for a rest and the farmer spent all winter trying to roll it into a snowman.
i_clumber.lore.rare: Walks so solemnly through the park that people take their hats off. Pigeons have started forming a procession behind it.

i_pug.names.legendary: Sir Snortimer, Keeper of the Sunny Spot
i_pug.lore.epic: Its curly tail wound up so tight with excitement that it spun the pug like a top across the whole kitchen floor. The tiles are now beautifully polished.
i_pug.lore.legendary: Sat on so many laps that it was given its own chair at every family dinner in town. It eats from all of them.

i_flat_coated_retriever.lore.legendary: Retrieved so many things from the lake in one summer that the lake had to file a lost-property report. Top of the list: the lifeguard.

i_old_english_sheepdog.lore.legendary: Was hired to dust the cathedral ceiling by standing on a ladder and shaking. Found two lost choir hats and a sleepy bat in its fringe.
i_old_english_sheepdog.lore.epic: Rolled down the hill at the village fun run like a giant ball of wool and won first, second and third place.

i_mexican_hairless.lore.epic: Tried on every jumper at the winter market to find one that fits. The stallholders are now knitting only in its size.
i_mexican_hairless.lore.legendary: Was carved into so many temple statues that it now poses whenever it sees a sculptor. It says every side is its good side.

i_leonberg.lore.legendary: Was mistaken for the lion on the town crest so often that it now sits for the new coat of arms every year. The real lion has been asked to stand aside.
i_leonberg.lore.rare: Lay down on the beach for a nap and the children built a sandcastle on it, thinking it was a dune with a mane.

i_saint_bernard.lore.common: Lies across the whole hallway like a draught excluder, then sighs every time you step over it.

i_beagle.lore.legendary: Howled one note so long and so tunefully that every beagle in the land answered. The concert lasted all weekend and was ended by a single dropped sausage.

i_french_bulldog.lore.epic: Its bat ears caught the wind on a blustery day and it floated over two gardens. Landed on a café table and ordered nothing.

i_samoyed.lore.epic: Smiled at the ice-cream van so sweetly that it gave away every lolly. The van now parks two streets away.
i_samoyed.lore.legendary: Pulled a sled to the North Pole and back with a grin so wide the polar explorers forgot to take any photos of the Pole. Every picture is of the dog.
i_samoyed.lore.common: Sheds a cloud of white fluff on everything you wear. Black trousers are now a thing of the past.

i_miniature_pinscher.lore.legendary: Marched in the town's grand parade with knees so high that the brass band started following it instead of the drum major.
i_miniature_pinscher.lore.epic: Chased a Great Dane twice its height out of the dog park, then demanded the park be renamed after it. The council is considering it.

i_african_hunting_dog.lore.legendary: Shared its dinner so fairly with fifty pack-mates that the town council asked it to cut the birthday cake at every party.

i_dalmatian.lore.legendary: Joined the dots on its own back and found a perfect map to buried treasure. It was a bone. It was its own bone.

i_newfoundland.lore.rare: Paddled across the boating lake towing four pedalos and a swan. Nobody asked it to; it just thought they were going too slowly.
i_newfoundland.lore.epic: Sat in the paddling pool on a hot day. The water is now in the neighbour's garden and the paddling pool is a hat.

i_great_pyrenees.lore.legendary: Lay down in a snowfield for the winter and the ski school used it as a beginners' slope. It did not notice until spring.
i_great_pyrenees.lore.rare: Patrols the garden fence all night and files a full report every morning, in barks, at six o'clock.

i_lakeland_terrier.lore.legendary: Squeezed into the smallest gap between two fells and came out the other side of the Lake District. It now gives tours through the shortcut, one walker at a time.
i_lakeland_terrier.lore.epic: Barked at a rowing boat on the lake until it turned back. Then barked at the ferry. Then barked at the lake, which has started to ripple nervously.

i_rhodesian_ridgeback.lore.rare: Its ridge grows the wrong way, so it gets brushed backwards twice a day. It insists the rest of the dog is the bit growing wrong.
i_rhodesian_ridgeback.lore.legendary: Kept a pride of lions busy for an entire afternoon just by walking backwards and forwards with its hair the wrong way. The lions are still trying to work out which way it is facing.

i_rottweiler.lore.uncommon: Carries the shopping money in a purse round its neck and checks the change twice. The greengrocer has started rounding up out of fear.
i_rottweiler.lore.epic: Sat on the garden swing and the swing went all the way round. It now refuses to get off until it does it again.

i_bernese_mountain_dog.lore.legendary: Leaned on the town clock tower to say hello. Every clock in the valley is now five minutes slow, and everyone is very relaxed about it.
i_bernese_mountain_dog.lore.common: Sits on your feet when you try to leave. Its whole back end comes too.

i_greater_swiss_mountain_dog.lore.uncommon: Barks once at the church bell to tell it the time is wrong. The bell has started ringing quietly.
i_greater_swiss_mountain_dog.lore.legendary: Barked once on the highest Alp and the echo came back a week later from the next country, asking for directions home.

i_bouvier_des_flandres.lore.uncommon: Drives the cows to milking by walking very slowly behind them and looking disappointed. They have never once been late.
i_bouvier_des_flandres.lore.common: Its shaggy coat hides its eyes so well that it once guarded a garden gnome for a whole day by mistake.
i_bouvier_des_flandres.lore.epic: Herded the market's runaway cows back into their pen, then herded the vegetable stall in too. The carrots are now very well behaved.

i_pembroke.lore.legendary: Lay flat as a loaf on the village green and was mistaken for a bread roll at the summer fair. Won first prize in the baking tent.
i_pembroke.lore.rare: Runs so fast on such short legs that it looks like a fluffy wind-up toy. Children keep looking for the key.

i_cardigan.lore.epic: Ran under the tables at the wedding and herded every ankle onto the dance floor. The band has never had such a full room.

i_black_and_tan_coonhound.lore.epic: Bayed under the moon so mournfully that every dog in town howled along, and the cats organised a petition.
i_black_and_tan_coonhound.lore.legendary: Its ears are so long it once tripped over them, rolled down a hill and treed itself. It is still very proud of the catch.

i_redbone.lore.epic: Swam across a flooded river after a scent and came out shining like a new penny. The river looks duller now.
i_redbone.lore.common: Sniffs every tree on the walk twice, in case it changed its mind about the smell.

i_english_setter.lore.epic: Crouched so low in the long grass that the farmer mowed round it all summer. The setter-shaped patch is now a local landmark.
i_english_setter.lore.rare: So gentle that the ducks let it walk them across the road. The lollipop lady has asked for lessons.

i_german_short_haired_pointer.lore.rare: Pointed at a duck, swam out, fetched it, swam back and pointed at it again to be sure. The duck is exhausted.
i_german_short_haired_pointer.lore.epic: Swam after a duck across the reservoir, came back, and swam over again to say goodbye properly. The reservoir now has a lane for it.

i_german_shepherd.lore.legendary: Was a police dog, a guide dog, a mountain rescuer and a film star, all before lunch. Spent the afternoon guarding the sofa.
i_german_shepherd.lore.common: Lies across the doorway with one ear up, so you can never tell if it is asleep. Neither can it.

i_bloodhound.lore.legendary: Solved every case in the detective's notebook just by sniffing the pages. The final page was the detective's lunch, which is why the notebook is shorter now.

i_affenpinscher.lore.legendary: Sneaked into the zoo's monkey house and lived there for a month. The monkeys taught it nothing; it taught them to bark at the postman.

deer.lore.uncommon: Leaves exactly one bite out of every lettuce in the vegetable patch, so nobody can blame it for eating a whole one.

i_ibizan_hound.lore.uncommon: Its nose turns pink when it is embarrassed, so everyone knows who ate the cake.

i_giant_schnauzer.lore.epic: Guarded the market so well that the pigeons now queue at a little gate and show their feet before they land.
i_giant_schnauzer.lore.common: Raises one bushy eyebrow at the hoover. The hoover has started switching itself off.

i_bluetick.lore.epic: Followed a trail so old that it led to the grandmother of the raccoon. She was very surprised to have a visitor.

i_great_dane.lore.uncommon: Tries to sit on the armchair like the cat. Gets one leg on, then looks at you as if the chair is broken.

i_maltese_dog.lore.rare: Its white coat is so long that it hides its legs, so people think it glides. The cat has started checking under it for wheels.

i_chesapeake_bay_retriever.lore.epic: Broke through the ice on the frozen bay to fetch a duck. The ice skaters now have a very straight canal through their rink.

i_komondor.lore.epic: Got caught in the rain and its cords soaked up a whole puddle each. It now weighs as much as a small car and refuses to go indoors until it drips dry.
i_komondor.lore.legendary: Was entered in a mop-throwing contest by mistake. Won it, then walked home on its own carrying the trophy.

i_appenzeller.lore.epic: Barked once on the Alp and the cowbells rang back. Now they argue every morning, and the cheese factory has to wear earplugs.
i_appenzeller.lore.legendary: Curled its tail so tight with pride that it went round twice. The village now uses it to wind the clock tower.

i_entlebucher.lore.epic: Ran rings around the ski lift all afternoon. The skiers got so dizzy they skied uphill.
i_entlebucher.lore.legendary: Volunteered to herd the clouds off the mountain before the tourists arrived. It is too small to reach them, but it barks at them very firmly and they do go.

i_australian_terrier.lore.common: Barks at every garden hose in case it is a snake. Has never once been right, and never once stopped.

i_airedale.lore.epic: Delivered every parcel in town before the post van woke up. The postman now rides in the back.
i_airedale.lore.rare: Is too big to fit down any burrow, so it barks into each one and waits. Several rabbits have come out just to complain.

i_cocker_spaniel.lore.rare: Flushed a pheasant out of a hedge so fast that the pheasant landed in a picnic basket. The picnic is now a pheasant.
i_cocker_spaniel.lore.epic: Its long ears dried in the wind like two flags, and the sailing club used them to tell the wind direction all summer.

i_chow.lore.legendary: Sat in the palace throne room for one afternoon and was mistaken for the emperor for ten years. Nobody noticed, because the old emperor had also never smiled.

i_english_springer.lore.legendary: Sniffed out every lost tennis ball in the country in one summer and returned them all to the same tennis club. Members now play with forty balls at once.
i_english_springer.lore.epic: Jumped into a hedge to check for birds and came out the other side of the maze. The maze has had to be redesigned.

i_boxer.lore.epic: Played boxing with the punchbag at the gym and won on points. The punchbag has asked for a rematch.

i_brittany_spaniel.lore.epic: Pointed at a pigeon on the town hall roof for so long that the council added it to the weather vane.

i_afghan_hound.lore.epic: Was called back in the park by twenty people at once. Ignored all of them so elegantly that they applauded.
i_afghan_hound.lore.legendary: Came back from a mountain walk with every tangle from the whole range in its coat. The hairdresser is still brushing out a small goat.

i_brabancon_griffon.lore.epic: Cleared the royal stables of mice and then sat on the coach roof to accept the applause. The horses were not consulted.

i_cairn.lore.epic: Dug after a rabbit under the castle wall and came up inside the gift shop wearing a tea towel.
i_cairn.lore.rare: Fearlessly squeezes into any rock gap after a rat, then barks from inside until the hill echoes like a drum.

i_border_terrier.lore.epic: Kept up with the whole hunt on its little legs, then rode home on the horse's saddle looking like it won.

wombat.lore.epic: Looked slow, so the village challenged it to the fun run. Finished, went home and had a nap before second place arrived.

x_alpaca_animal.lore.epic: All the alpacas in the field queued politely for the same corner. The village bus stop has started copying them.
x_alpaca_animal.lore.legendary: Was shorn at the county fair and its fleece knitted enough jumpers for the whole village. It now walks around naked and looking very pleased.

x_koala_bear.lore.legendary: Left its fingerprints at the scene of every missing biscuit in town. Detectives keep arresting the police chief by mistake.

i_polecat.lore.epic: Moved into the hen house for one night. The hens are now sleeping on the church roof and refuse to discuss it.
i_polecat.lore.legendary: Hid so many eggs in its den for winter that it hatched its own farm. Now it sells breakfast to the foxes.

x_llama_animal.lore.legendary: Was hired to guard a flock and gave every fox such a long disapproving stare that the foxes became vegetarians.

i_japanese_spaniel.lore.epic: Climbed to the top of the palace curtains and refused to come down until dinner was served up there.

i_italian_greyhound.lore.legendary: Found the only sunbeam in the whole of Italy on a cloudy day and lay in it. The tourists queued to stand next to it.

i_borzoi.lore.epic: Put its long nose through the letterbox to say hello. The postman now delivers letters straight into its mouth.

i_dandie_dinmont.lore.legendary: Squeezed into a badger's sett and found three lost umbrellas, a teapot and the badger's old school photo. Brought them all home.

i_dhole.lore.epic: Shared one picnic sandwich between thirty pack members so fairly that every crumb had a name.

i_keeshond.lore.legendary: Puffed up its ruff to say hello on a windy day and floated gently along the canal like a hot-air balloon. The ducks waved.

i_kelpie.lore.epic: Worked so hard in the heat that the farmer's hat wilted. The kelpie lent it its shade and kept going.

i_kerry_blue_terrier.lore.epic: Took on the vacuum cleaner, the lawnmower and the leaf blower in one afternoon. All three are now kept in the shed with the light on.
i_kerry_blue_terrier.lore.legendary: Turned a little bluer every year until it was the exact colour of the sky. Lost for an hour every sunny day.

i_kuvasz.lore.epic: Lay down in the snow to watch the flock and the farmer built a snowman next to it. Nobody has worked out which one is guarding.

i_lhasa.lore.epic: Its fringe grew so long it swept the whole monastery corridor. The monks stopped buying brooms.

i_miniature_poodle.lore.epic: Swam the boating lake with its pompoms puffed up like floats. Two ducks hitched a ride.
i_miniature_poodle.lore.legendary: Taught itself to read the recipe book and baked a cake for the whole street. Left out the sugar because poodles are very health-conscious.

i_papillon.lore.rare: Its ears flutter so much in the wind that it took off from the garden wall and glided to next door's barbecue. It says it was the wind.

i_norfolk_terrier.lore.epic: Joined in the village tug-of-war on the losing side and grinned so cheerfully that the other team let go to pat it.

i_norwich_terrier.lore.epic: Sat in a farmer's welly to keep warm, and the farmer walked to the market before noticing. It sold a cabbage while it was there.
i_norwich_terrier.lore.legendary: Scared off a wild boar with one bark, then asked the boar to help carry the shopping home.

i_norwegian_elkhound.lore.legendary: Held a moose at bay for so long that the moose moved in. They now share the porch and argue about the weather.

i_otterhound.lore.epic: Bayed once at the village pond and the echo bounced around the valley for a week. The church clock now chimes in a hound voice.

i_curly_coated_retriever.lore.epic: Hid a tennis ball in its curls for a whole week. Nobody could find it, including the curly-coat.

i_groenendael.lore.legendary: Ran so fast through the dark that it beat its own shadow home. The shadow has asked for a rematch.

i_briard.lore.epic: Its fringe flew up in a gust of wind and the sheep saw its eyes for the first time. They have been on their best behaviour ever since.

i_irish_setter.lore.legendary: Ran through an autumn forest so fast that the leaves thought it was a gust of wind and all fell at once. The park keeper is still raking.

i_bedlington_terrier.lore.epic: Raced the village whippets and won while still looking like a cushion. The whippets have asked for a recount.

i_boston_bull.lore.legendary: Wore its tuxedo to every wedding in town for so long that brides started sending it the seating plan first.

i_basenji.lore.legendary: Refused to go out in the rain for so long that the town built it a covered street. Everyone else uses it now too.

i_basset.lore.legendary: Lay down in the middle of the street and its ears covered both pavements. The council painted a zebra crossing on them.

i_english_foxhound.lore.legendary: Led forty hounds into the village bakery at once. Nobody touched a bun; they just wanted to see. The baker cried with relief.

i_chihuahua.lore.legendary: Became bodyguard to a film star and held back a thousand photographers. Then bit the star's shoelace for walking too slowly.

i_pekinese.lore.legendary: Was made the emperor's guard lion and kept the post for life. It guarded mainly the emperor's slippers, and slept in them.

i_red_wolf.lore.legendary: Brought the whole family back to the old forest and howled so proudly that the trees rustled back. The owls are now taking bookings for the next reunion.

i_doberman.lore.uncommon: Leans on your legs while you cook, so you stir with one hand and hold it up with the other.

i_eskimo_dog.lore.epic: Dug itself a snow bed outside, slept through a blizzard and woke up as the centre of a new igloo village. It charges no rent.

i_miniature_schnauzer.lore.common: Its beard collects a bit of every meal, so it carries yesterday's dinner around as a snack for later.
